_readme: One record per published price, price range, discount, or comparative price claim.
The Owner decision is not 'never publish a price'. It is: no price without an ACS
price AND an effective date. The date is the whole point — a price published with no
expiry does not stay correct, it rots silently on a live page while still looking
sourced. So valid_until is mandatory, and evidence-check.mjs fails a record whose
Scope is part of the price. '18,500 บาท' means nothing until it says whether that is
per unit, includes VAT, includes installation, or assumes a minimum quantity.

validity._note: Both YYYY-MM-DD. valid_until is mandatory: a price with no expiry is a price nobody will ever re-check.

_wording_rule: The visible copy must carry the effective date and the scope. 'ราคา X บาท (ราคา ณ วันที่ YYYY-MM-DD, ต่อเครื่อง, ยังไม่รวม VAT)'.
